name: JM Shipping Solution
author: jmshipping

sections.description:
JM® Shipping Solution by Jewelers Mutual® Group simplifies shipping in your WooCommerce store. Configure methods, set real-time rates from top carriers like FedEx, UPS, and USPS, and insure shipments effortlessly. Seamlessly connect your store to streamline order fulfillment and return precise shipping options at checkout. JM Shipping Solution helps you manage shipments with ease while providing a smooth experience for your customers. You will need a Zing Marketplace account to use this app.

Features

  1. Buy labels from major carriers without reentering shipping details
  2. Add insurance to shipments for worry-free delivery
  3. Configure shipping methods and set rates with real-time quotes
  4. Automatically sync orders with your JM Shipping Solution account
  5. Manage shipments through a modern, intuitive interface
sections.installation:
1. Sign in (or register) to your free JM® Shipping solution account in Zing® Marketplace.
  2. Log into your WooCommerce admin account in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add Plugin from the left sidebar.
  4. Search for JM® Shipping Solution.
  5. Install Now or select View More Details to learn more.
  6. Review the JM WooCommerce instructions in your JM® Shipping Solution account for set up details.
  7. Then configure your store defaults and shipment methods.
  8. Enable the app in your admin account once setup is complete.
sections.faq:
Where can I find documentation?

One the plugin is installed, you will have access to a complete instruction file. Additionally, you can access this information from your free JM® Shipping Solution account in Zing® Marketplace.

Where can I get support?

If you have questions after reviewing the instruction file, contact us at shipping@jminsure.com for additional support.

What else do I need?

You must be registered for a free JM® Shipping Solution account in Zing® Marketplace.
